search_scope.method: Search all Lean source for the exact target and shared declaration names, then inspect every plausible error-free-transform, compensated-summation, extended-dot-product, recursive-summation, final-rounding, and gamma declaration semantically. Text matching alone was not treated as proof of absence or duplication.

recorded_searches.purpose: exact target-name and benchmark-only shared-name search
recorded_searches.result: No exact P02 target or benchmark-only shared declaration occurs in either searched codebase.
No paper-native VecSum, SumK, or DotK declaration was found. TwoProduct wording appears only in unrelated local discussions; no error-free TwoProduct transform implements Algorithm 5.10.
The library contains exact compensated-prefix invariants and separate recursive-summation, final-rounding, and gamma ingredients, but no shared VecSum or Sum2 proposition.
The library has ordinary one-level extended-precision and exact-product dot bounds, but no iterated error-free transform or Proposition 5.11 analogue.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.alternativeCompensatedPrefixSum_add_corrections_eq_sum_of_exact_steps
closest_declarations.relationship: It proves the same kind of loop-level exact-sum invariant for the library's alternative compensated trace, not the paper's shared VecSum cascade.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.fl_alternativeCompensatedMainSum_add_exact_corrections_eq_sum_of_exact_steps
closest_declarations.relationship: It is a full-length exact-prefix corollary on a different execution surface and is a close direct-use ingredient.

task_findings.tier_assessment: T1 is honest: a close basic invariant exists, while the exact fixed shared target is absent.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.alternativeCompensatedPrefixCorrections_abs_le_recursiveSum_forward
closest_declarations.relationship: It supplies a related exact-correction versus recursive-error bridge but not Lemma 4.2 or the Sum2 result.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.recursiveSum_forward_error_bound
closest_declarations.relationship: It supplies the ordinary recursive-summation ingredient after an adapter.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.finalRound_error_bound
closest_declarations.relationship: It supplies generic final-rounding algebra, but not the paper-specific cancellation or squared gamma coefficient.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.gamma_mono
closest_declarations.relationship: It is one of several gamma facts needed to organize the final arithmetic.

task_findings.tier_assessment: T2 is honest: multiple library facts plus substantial paper-specific VecSum/Sum2 bridges must be combined.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.extendedDotProduct_error_bound
closest_declarations.relationship: It treats one inner-precision computation followed by final rounding, not Algorithm 5.10's iterated error-free transform.

closest_declarations.name: NumStability.exactMulDotProduct_error_bound
closest_declarations.relationship: It gives an ordinary exact-product dot bound and has no TwoProduct low vector, VecSum cascade, or K-fold estimate.

task_findings.tier_assessment: T3 is honest: the proof must add new iterated VecSum/SumK and transformed-product infrastructure before reaching the stated gamma bound.

overall_conclusion.qualification: T1 and T2 have intentionally disclosed nearby reusable library ingredients. T3 remains substantially beyond the frozen library.
